verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Smooth offers its own sandbox, test mode, or test API keys that keep its tasks isolated from production data. The localhost tunnel (smooth-docs-25) lets agents reach a user's own dev servers. That is a user-side arrangement and an adjacent feature, not a Smooth sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
